scope: Conditional comparison for initial survey survivors through the sealed b005 snapshot; not later dossier selection.

null_controls.survivor_definition: Any automatic-triage survivor on a host; vetting errors count as survivors

real_run_snapshot.snapshot_limits: Live search, completion, vet and retention frontiers are asynchronous; these are dated counters, not final population completeness.

comparison.interpretation: If transformed controls represent the survey background, about 37% of initial survivors could be noise/stellar-variability false alarms before eclipsing binaries. The upper endpoint cannot rule out most or all.
limits: Transfer from finite transformed controls to the real survey is an assumption, not established exchangeability.
This is a conditional population-rate comparison, not an individual FAP/FPP.
Not a measured contamination fraction for b005 selected dossiers.
Eclipsing binaries, blends and astrophysical alternatives require separate assessment.
The asynchronous live-run snapshot is not a final survey rate.
No probability or contamination fraction is assigned to the49 selected dossiers.
